hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" && { printf -- '- %s stop: branch %s, %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') dirty file(s)" >> tasks/session-log.md; } ; jq -n --arg b "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" '{systemMessage: ("abbey-bot stop — branch " + $b + "; gate is ./check.sh; ledger tasks/goals.md; note appended to tasks/session-log.md")}'
